name: Moog Subsequent 25
description: Moog Subsequent 25 paraphonic analog synthesizer: the MIDI CC table of its manual.

sources.title: Subsequent 25 Manual
sources.notes: MIDI CC table (pages 45, 46, 47, 48) read by tools/profiles/moog/read-moog-pdf.mjs from Subsequent_25_Manual_Web.pdf (sha256 97f37ca1f7171db1372b4db8de14832bda00484f7925fec2f52fed0b9f072a63), https://cdn.inmusicbrands.com/Moog/Subsequent25/Subsequent_25_Manual_Web.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/moog/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/moog/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the manual prints no Device Inquiry reply.
When the LFO is synced, its rate (CC 3) selects a clock division instead; the manual's table of those is not a setting of its own and is not read.

28 knob(s) are 14-bit, 0 - 16383: the MSB and the LSB the table prints, sent in that order: Mod Wheel (CC 1, LSB 33); Filter Mod Amount (CC 2, LSB 34); LFO Rate (CC 3, LSB 35); Pitch Mod Amount (CC 4, LSB 36); Glide Rate (CC 5, LSB 37); Master Volume (CC 7, LSB 39); Noise Level (CC 8, LSB 40); VCO 1 Wave (CC 9, LSB 41); VCO 2 Frequency (CC 12, LSB 44); VCO 2 Beat (CC 13, LSB 45); VCO 2 Wave (CC 14, LSB 46); VCO 1 Level (CC 15, LSB 47); VCO 2 Level (CC 16, LSB 48); VCO 1 Sub Level (CC 17, LSB 49); MultiDrive Amount (CC 18, LSB 50); Filter Cutoff (CC 19, LSB 51); Wave Mod Amount (CC 20, LSB 52); Filter Resonance (CC 21, LSB 53); Filter EG Amount (CC 22, LSB 54); Filter EG Attack (CC 23, LSB 55); Filter EG Decay (CC 24, LSB 56); Filter EG Sustain (CC 25, LSB 57); Filter EG Release (CC 26, LSB 58); Filter KB Amount (CC 27, LSB 59); Amp EG Attack (CC 28, LSB 60); Amp EG Decay (CC 29, LSB 61); Amp EG Sustain (CC 30, LSB 62); Amp EG Release (CC 31, LSB 63).
A number, not a choice, where its bands are printed out of order (0-42, 3-85, 86-127): Wave Mod Destination (CC 72).
A number, not a choice, where its bands are printed out of order (0-31, 32-64, 64-95, 96-127): Note Priority (CC 111).
